name: browser-use
headline: Swift Concurrency Migration - Automate Code
short_description: Automates migration of Swift codebases to Swift Concurrency. Benefits iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS developers by identifying and refactoring legacy code. Integrates with Xcode and CI/CD pipelines to streamline the migration process.
author: kylehughes

sections.overview:
The Unofficial Swift Concurrency Migration Skill provides the complete content of Apple's official Swift Concurrency Migration Guide in a structured format optimized for Claude and other LLMs. It includes all documentation articles and Swift code examples needed to modernize Swift codebases using async/await and actor-based concurrency. The skill integrates with Claude Code and can be configured at the project level via `.claude/settings.json`, making migration guidance available to entire development teams. Developers working on iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS projects can use this skill to understand patterns, identify legacy code patterns, and learn refactoring strategies. The skill is automatically updated nightly to stay current with the official documentation.
Learning async/await patterns and concurrency best practices
Identifying legacy callback and GCD patterns in existing code
Understanding actor model and data isolation requirements
Team-wide migration planning with shared skill configuration
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/kylehughes/the-unofficial-swift-concurrency-migration-skill`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
